title: UI audit baseline and page-length and naming checks
scope: Capture before-screenshots of every auditor and taxpayer screen at 1440x900 and add browser checks that fail when an operational screen exceeds the page-length budget or user-visible text names an open-source component

acceptance.text: A screen inventory with before-screenshots and measured page heights for every auditor and taxpayer route, including the taxpayer app against a running Frappe site or with the reason it could not run

A Playwright check measures each operational route at 1440x900 against the DESIGN_STANDARD.md budget (1.5 viewport heights, tables scroll inside a labelled region) and reports the worst offenders; the showcase is exempt

A naming check fails when visible text or accessible names contain a banned component name from the DESIGN_STANDARD.md register (Jube, OpenAleph, Frappe, Docling, yente, LangGraph, Groq) outside the About page and Admin diagnostics; it starts as a report and becomes blocking in TAX-150
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Playwright report on the fixture build plus screenshots in docs/evidence/TAX-144

notes.text: Added 2026-11-08 from ADR-044 (one Vati Workspace identity and design system v2) after the user's UI review against Cloudflare's dashboard and Zoho Workplace.
